verdict.rationale: Perplexity is a consumer AI assistant, so a training-data opt-out is a fair question for this kind of product and the axis applies. However, none of the evidence documents any setting, toggle or policy that lets users control whether their conversations are used for model training. The evidence covers search, the API, the CLI, MCP and app features instead, and the community items are about crawling and product quality.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can control whether my conversations are used to train models
